'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Sam Marlow LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Sam Marlow]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''2/2'''. L1 Coruscant: Night Club; start is It Is The Future You See (V) at L2. L20 second Master Qui-Gon is not (V). L50 struck prefix, then Leia's Blaster Rifle.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|It Is The Future You See (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Hari Seldon
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
